description.zh: 是否激活；取值0或1，取值说明 0：不激活，1激活，默认激活
description.en: Specifies whether the agent is active. Valid values: `0` (inactive) and `1` (active). The default value is `1` (active).

description.zh: 座席类型；取值1或2，取值说明 1：电话座席，2：电脑座席，默认电话座席
description.en: The agent type. Valid values: `1` (phone agent) and `2` (computer agent). The default value is `1` (phone agent).

description.zh: 座席所属区号
description.en: The agent's area code.

description.zh: 呼叫权限；取值说明 0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
description.en: The call permission. Valid values: `0` (unrestricted), `1` (domestic long-distance), `2` (local), and `3` (internal calls only). The default value is `0` (unrestricted).

description.zh: 座席工号列表；需要批量更新座席的工号列表，多个之间使用英文标点逗号间隔，最多支持100个座席的批量更新。例如："0001,0002,00103"；座席工号，正整数，取值3-10位数字
description.en:
A comma-separated list of the agent IDs to update. You can specify a maximum of 100 IDs.
Each agent ID must be a positive integer from 3 to 10 digits long.

description.zh: 备注
description.en: The comment.

description.zh: 呼叫中心 id
description.en: The call center ID.

description.zh: 呼入是否录音；取值说明 0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
description.en: Specifies whether to enable inbound recording. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1` (enabled).

description.zh: 是否开启ASR转写；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认不开启
description.en: Specifies whether to enable ASR transcription. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `0` (disabled).

description.zh: 是否允许外呼；取值说明 0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
description.en: Specifies whether the agent can make outbound calls. Valid values: `0` (disallowed) and `1` (allowed). The default value is `1` (allowed).

description.zh: 外呼主叫记忆开关；取值说明：0：关闭 1：开启；默认开启
description.en: Specifies whether to enable outbound caller ID memory. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1` (enabled).

description.zh: 是否开启座席质检；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认开启
description.en: Specifies whether to enable agent quality check. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1` (enabled).

description.zh: 随机外显；取值说明 0:否，1:是。当obClidType值为4时需要传值，默认值为0
description.en: Specifies whether to use a random caller ID. Valid values: `0` (No) and `1` (Yes). This parameter is required if `ObClidType` is set to `4`. The default value is `0` (No).

description.zh: 座席姓名；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
description.en: The agent name. The value must be URL-encoded in UTF-8.

description.zh: 透传号码；可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码，当obClidType值为2或3时必选
description.en: The outbound caller ID. You can specify a corporate trunk number or a custom outbound caller ID. This parameter is required when `ObClidType` is set to `2` or `3`.

description.zh: 外显属性；取值：{"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1}；obClidType=4时，isMatchCapital表示是否匹配省会号码，1是 0否，areaCodeRule表示区号匹配规则，1座席区号 2客户号码区号（注意：json格式数据需要URLencode）
description.en:
The outbound caller ID properties, in URL-encoded JSON format. This parameter is used when `ObClidType` is set to `4`.
The JSON object contains the following fields:
`isMatchCapital`: Specifies whether to use a caller ID from a provincial capital. Valid values: `1` (Yes) and `0` (No).
`areaCodeRule`: The area code matching rule. Valid values: `1` (Use the agent's area code) and `2` (Use the customer's area code).

description.zh: 外显规则；取值：1:默认 2:随机 3:按区号 4 动态外显 ，默认值为1
description.en: The outbound caller ID rule. Valid values: `1` (default), `2` (random), `3` (by area code), and `4` (dynamic caller ID). The default value is `1` (default).

description.zh: 外呼是否录音；取值说明 0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
description.en: Specifies whether to enable outbound recording. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1` (enabled).
The outbound call time window. The value must be in the `HH:mm,HH:mm` format.

description.zh: 座席权限；取值1或0，取值说明 1：班长席，0：普通座席，默认为0 普通座席
description.en: The agent's permission level. Valid values: `1` (supervisor) and `0` (standard agent). The default value is `0` (standard agent).

description.zh: webrtc软电话返回地址；取值说明：0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP
description.en: The type of endpoint address returned for the WebRTC softphone. Valid values: `0` (enterprise default), `1` (public domain), `2` (leased-line domain), `3` (public IP), and `4` (leased-line IP). The default value is `0` (enterprise default).

description.zh: 整理时间；单位秒数，默认10秒
description.en: The wrap-up time, in seconds. The default value is 10.
